name: Bleeding
description:
Bleeding: Lose 1 HP per round per Bleed DMG until treated
Res.: Skill check (+1 DIF if performed on self), any magic that heals HP
notes: Two consecutive checks needed to fully resolve chain

name: Gushing
description:
Gushing: Lose 2 HP per round with heavy bleeding, persists until skill-check treatment, and must downgrade to Bleeding before ending.
Res.: Skill check (+1 DIF if performed on self), any magic that heals HP reduces to Bleeding
notes: Must downgrade to Bleeding before ending

name: Dying / Unconscious
description: At 0 HP and losing HP each round, cannot act or move, and ends only by stabilization or healing (death at negative HP threshold).

name: Fuzzy
description:
Fuzzy: PER −2, 25% miss chance, TAC −1
Res.: Skill check (+1 DIF if performed on self), any magic that heals HP, or 4 rounds without further eye injury

name: Blinded
description:
Blinded: PER −4, 50% miss chance, TAC −2
Res.: Skill check (+1 DIF if performed on self), any magic that heals HP, or 4 rounds without further eye injury steps to Fuzzy

name: Hidden
description: Hidden: Gain +2 attack and enables sneak attacks, lasts while concealed, ends when revealed or interacting.
effectsMechanical: Bonus to hit and enables sneak attacks

name: Poisoned
description: Variable damage and penalties by poison type, lasts per poison rules, ends by saves or antidote.

name: Prone
description:
Prone: Knocked down with mobility limits and TAC shift
Res.: Large Action to stand
notes: TAC shifts handled in combat logic

name: Shaken
description: Shaken: −1 to rolls, persists while the fear source remains, steps down when the source is removed.

name: Frightened
description: Frightened: −2 to rolls and cannot act, immobilized by fear, steps down when the source is removed.

name: Horrified
description: Horrified: Forced to flee the fear source, persists while exposed, downgrades as fear subsides.

name: Winded
description:
Winded: No Large Actions and only one Small Action
Res.: Skill check (+1 DIF if performed on self), any magic that heals HP , short or long rest

name: Poisoned: Neurotoxin
description: −2 AGI, −1 Dodge; fail by 5+ Slowed (1 SA); Toughness save; 1 min per failed save; ends on successful save, antivenom, or magic.
effectsMechanical: −2 AGI; −1 Dodge; fail by 5+: Slowed (1 SA only)

name: Poisoned: Hemophilia
description: Damage causes Bleeding and upgrades to Gushing; no natural healing; Toughness save; lasts until removed; ends with save, medicine, or magic.
effectsMechanical: Damage causes Bleeding; Bleeding upgrades to Gushing; no natural healing
resolutionRule: Ends on successful Toughness save or treatment

name: Poisoned: Hallucinogen
description: −2 PER, −2 skills; fail by 5+ Frightened; Resist save; 10 min per failed save; ends on save or time.
resolutionRule: Ends on successful Resist save or time

name: Poisoned: Paralytic
description: No Large Actions, speed 0; fail by 5+ Prone; Toughness save; 1 min per failed save; ends on save, medicine, or magic.
effectsMechanical: No Large Actions; fail by 5+: Prone

name: Poisoned: Toxic
description: Ongoing body damage; fail by 5+ Stopped (Encumbered); Toughness save; 1 min per failed save; ends on save, medicine, or magic.
effectsMechanical: Ongoing body damage; fail by 5+: Stopped (Encumbered)

name: Poisoned: Sedative
description: −2 STR, −2 END; fail by 5+ Unconscious 1d3 rounds; Toughness save; 10 min per failed save; ends on save, medicine, or magic.
effectsMechanical: −2 STR; −2 END; fail by 5+: Unconscious 1d3 rounds
